verdict.rationale: Stripe's webhooks documentation explicitly supports automatic reactions to events (docs-38), and Smart Disputes automates part of the dispute workflow (docs-40), giving a basic event-triggered automation capability. However, this is a raw webhook/event system requiring custom code rather than a declarative rules engine an AI-native user could configure directly, and there's no Terminal-specific rules/automation builder. Missing for 10: a no-code or declarative rule-definition interface, Terminal-specific event-trigger examples, and independent/hands-on evidence of automation reliability.
